header.title: Privacy Policy
header.subtitle: Learn how FRESCO collects, uses, and protects your information when you browse our website or use our services.

sec1.title: Information We Collect
sec1.p1: When you use FRESCO, we may collect information that you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, shipping details, and account information.
sec1.p2: We may also collect technical information about your interaction with our website, including browser information, device information, and usage data.

sec2.title: How We Use Information
sec2.p1: We use collected information to provide and improve our services, process orders, communicate with you, maintain account functionality, and provide a smoother shopping experience.
sec2.list2: Maintain and improve your account experience.
sec2.list3: Respond to support requests and inquiries.
sec2.list4: Improve website functionality and user experience.

sec3.title: Data Security
sec3.p1: We take reasonable measures to protect the information associated with your account and your interactions with FRESCO. However, no method of transmission or electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
sec3.boxDesc: We aim to handle your information responsibly and use it only for legitimate business and service purposes.

sec4.title: Cookies
sec4.p1: FRESCO may use cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, support essential website functionality, and understand how visitors interact with the website.

sec5.title: Your Rights
sec5.p1: Depending on applicable laws, you may have rights regarding the personal information associated with your account, including requesting access, correction, or deletion of certain information.

sec6.title: Contact Us
sec6.p1: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact the FRESCO support team.

header.title: Terms of Service
header.subtitle: Rules and guidelines for using our platform

intro.title: Please read carefully
intro.desc: By accessing or using FRESCO, you agree to follow these terms and conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please do not use the website.

sec1.title: Acceptance of Terms
sec1.p1: By accessing and using the FRESCO website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and any applicable policies referenced on the website.

sec2.title: Account Registration
sec2.p1: Some features may require you to create an account. You are responsible for providing accurate information and maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
sec2.p2: You are responsible for activities performed through your account and should notify FRESCO if you believe your account has been accessed without authorization.

sec3.title: Products & Orders
sec3.p1: Product information, descriptions, images, prices, and availability are displayed as part of the shopping experience. We may update product information or availability when necessary.
sec3.p2: Placing an order does not necessarily guarantee its fulfillment. Orders may be subject to availability and other applicable conditions.

sec4.title: Pricing & Payments
sec4.p1: Prices displayed on FRESCO may change without prior notice. The applicable price is the price presented during the relevant purchasing process.
sec4.p2: Payment information should be provided accurately when completing a purchase. Additional payment terms may apply depending on the selected payment method.

sec5.title: User Responsibilities
sec5.p1: You agree to use FRESCO only for lawful purposes and in a way that does not interfere with the operation, security, or availability of the website.
sec5.p2: You must not attempt to gain unauthorized access to accounts, systems, services, or information belonging to FRESCO or other users.

sec6.title: Intellectual Property
sec6.p1: Unless otherwise stated, content presented on FRESCO, including text, graphics, branding, interface elements, and other materials, is intended for use within the website and may not be reproduced or distributed without appropriate authorization.

sec7.title: Limitation of Liability
sec7.p1: FRESCO aims to provide an accurate and reliable shopping experience. However, the website and its services may occasionally be unavailable, interrupted, or contain inaccuracies.
sec7.p2: To the extent permitted by applicable law, FRESCO is not responsible for losses arising from circumstances outside its reasonable control.

sec8.title: Changes to These Terms
sec8.p1: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Changes become effective when the updated terms are published on the website.

sec9.title: Contact Us
sec9.p1: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please contact the FRESCO support team.
